title: Complete the QQ16 native selected-sum decoder
head: 630d557af5088f66b45c447969cee9576600e50b
body:
PR2511 supplies a complete logical selected-sum decoder, while PR2512 supplies current-frame L2 reads. This composes them into the complete **added local native decoder**, including early-record capture, temporal ownership, all remaining reconstruction, source restoration and record retirement. It returns all **224 original logical arrays in the common physical frame F_U1**. That output frame is explicit; it does not claim restoration of the original pre-F0 physical frames.

The exact added invoice is **224 rank-one + 16 rank-eight children (native mass 352), 480 native wrappers, 208 full-cover maps and 17,472 real scalar primitives**. The scalar bill comprises 856 unit ADDs, 832 quarter ADDs and 320 CLEARs, including 160 primitives for early capture and 32 for retirement. The inherited F0/B1 calls keep their own costs; the word's history marker is not a free gate.

Sixteen separate owned early banks capture selected X after F0 and remain unchanged through B1. Their values are copied into the eventual selected X outputs, which are upgraded once to F_U1. Eight of those owned outputs feed the L2 correction and remain available. The actual F0 owner chart is identity, so a complete local inverse recovers all original X with sixteen local scratch arrays. Original selected Y is built directly in the eventual Y outputs from the paid current sums; no separate selected-sum bank is allocated. All **224 borrowed current physical X/Y arrays restore**, all sixteen early banks retire, and all private scratch returns to zero. The caller supplies **224 owned full-cover output banks, 16 additional early banks and at most 16 local scratch arrays per owner**. No storage saving is inferred.

The package is `research/qq16-complete-native-decoder/`. Its proof and literal word track 240 independent temporal source symbols (16 earlier and 224 current) and arbitrary owned-buffer dirt, checking all 224 output operators against authenticated PR2511 logic. The retained logical decoder also checks both inverse orders on its actual 224-input and compressed-observation spaces. That machinery is explicitly reused with credit, not presented as an independent implementation.

Native evidence covers 104 actual translated maps, 281,008 complete phase-character comparisons, 114,688 signed line-basis columns and the retained 65,536-coefficient rank-eight kernel check. Twelve semantic controls reject capture after B1, missing upgrades/normalization/restoration, wrong owner payload shifts, an inverse sign, output dirt, borrowed clearing, leaked scratch and unretired early records. Six boundary test groups cover early retirement, private-sweep chronology, complete word/receipt requirements, source authentication before execution, Git-free read-only export and overwrite refusal.

Validation on Windows, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-complete-native-decoder
python3.14 -I -B -O research/qq16-complete-native-decoder/verify.py
```

Native **CPython 3.12.7 registered primary and six test groups pass**, and **3.14.5 optimized primary passes**. A separate AI reviewer found no material issue, passed the optimized3.12.7primary, and independently reimplemented the JSON-only scalar/ordered-owner replay: all224outputs with5840nonzero terms over240temporal symbols,104source-registry polarization maps, borrowed logical restoration, early capture/retirement and the complete invoice agree. This independent checker does not separately lower the native kernels or recertify the original full native F0/B1 words. No human review, proof assistant, hosted CI or selected supplier cold replay is claimed.

Physical retention, whole-cover movement, child hosting, scalar addresses, precision, use of the 224 outputs, global controller placement and all-size admission remain open. This is a complete finite added decoder invoice, not a favorable physical/supplier budget, minimum native count, new retention theorem or new kappa.

Base is freshly fetched canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. Source PR2511 is pinned at `f40e74a27f7c8781feea06a1571dc99ed5d9a004`; PR2512 at `851dd3486a2d0549b51e85978a65ccb4eec619c0`. Both heads and main were verified unchanged at 13:46 UTC. Exact predecessor bytes, Git blobs and SHA-256 pins are retained. The task-picker seed `6c82be10ab151cf0e67b46fabec4b461` selected recursive interfaces; the card scope is narrowed to this concrete missing decoder contract. Baseline bindings passed.

Overlap coverage is bounded: complete cached 679 open PRs at 12:25 UTC and 1,197 Discussion records at 12:29 UTC, supplemented with the latest 50 updated open PRs via REST at 13:30 UTC and targeted source/claim checks. GraphQL quota prevented a newer complete Discussion refresh. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2511#issuecomment-6193288068).

Credit ywz65's PR2511/2512 composition sources and PR2456/2468/2492 machinery, thakrarsagar/PR2470 for L2, starship-s/PR2443 for the original cut/F0 inverse, Ross Richardson/PR2480 for fixed-L2 retention, Ali Romman for QQ16 and the retained native/geometry/supplier lineage. Source notices remain. New work by **ywz65**, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, source inspection, implementation, testing, writing and review. Apache-2.0.
